units.en: As ⟦0⟧, found the ⟦1⟧ and have it encompass at least 13 different countries with capitals in Africa.

Regardless of which method you pick, this achievement is much easier if you do it with ⟦0⟧ enabled. After forming the African Union, you can edit the faction options and select the option that allows your faction to have Governments in Exile. Capitulated nations that are Governments in Exile still count as nations for this achievement, you can just hold out against the entire world in the mountains of ⟦1⟧, inviting rebelling nations into your faction for just an instant before they fall, and once you collect 13 fallen nations, you win.
The key to getting this achievement is ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. Both will have low compliance and resistance strength in their African provinces, making them an easy target for uprisings.
Start the game with historical focuses on.
Hold on until you can push back ⟦0⟧, but don't accept the peace event and don't do the focus ⟦1⟧. You want to max out the guns decision that you get from the focus ⟦2⟧.
When you've reclaimed all your cores continue the political side of the focus tree and take the ⟦0⟧ side.

The reason you go down the ⟦0⟧ side is that it leads towards ⟦1⟧. This will splinter your nation into many autonomous puppets (which don't count towards the achievement) and a small ⟦2⟧. But this makes it a lot harder for the enemy in case you have to do revolts in ⟦3⟧ (sometimes the part of the ⟦4⟧ Colonies below the Sahara Desert change from ⟦5⟧ to ⟦6⟧). The ⟦7⟧ can then only attack you on a couple of mountainous tiles (unless you decide for some strange reason to call in those puppets to fight with you), which are easy to defend with the 30ish (irregular) divisions you should have at that point. You could build some forts for comfort.
Make sure that around the time ⟦0⟧ declares war on ⟦1⟧ you have a good amount of political power (300+) and guns (10k+)
Once ⟦0⟧ has defeated ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ has appeared, take the 'Anti-French Propaganda' decision to increase resistance in their African Provinces.

Once that decision is done start boosting resistance in specific ⟦0⟧ provinces. The order in which you let those African Nations revolt is up to you. However, make sure that they are not neighbours. Because if for example ⟦1⟧ revolts, they take the neighbouring province (core state of Togo) and you were boosting resistance in that province as well. Then once ⟦2⟧ revolts they'll join the ⟦3⟧ (since they revolted against your ally). So only start boosting in provinces controlled by your enemies.

Remember to click the demand recognition decision (which appears 24 hours after the revolt), otherwise, they won't join your faction. For the achievement, it doesn't matter if they capitulate, only that you have at least 13 African Nations from the list in your faction.
Be aware that when ⟦0⟧ goes to war with the ⟦1⟧ that there is a chance that when a nation revolts that they will automatically join the ⟦2⟧ faction. But it shouldn't be more than 2 or 3 that do so.
If you're unlucky and haven't reached 13 members yet after you revolted all of the ⟦0⟧ African provinces, go for the ⟦1⟧ ones or the ⟦2⟧ ( ⟦3⟧ is pointless, far too high compliance).

Finally, and I am sure everyone knows this, but ⟦0⟧ is guaranteed by ⟦1⟧. So once you declare war on them through a "Demand recognition decision" they'll join the ⟦2⟧. But since you are at war with them anyway that doesn't really matter.

Tip: It is better to raise resistance in small or even one-state nations like ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧, as this will lead to an uprising much faster because of fewer states that have to meet the resistance threshold.
Perhaps faster and more consistent, but also a more difficult method to get this achievement
Simply go to war with the colonial powers and occupy enough territories in Africa to create 13 collaboration governments, which will count for the achievement once you complete the ⟦0⟧ focus.
Beware that to be able to create collaboration governments as ⟦0⟧ you need to do the focus ⟦1⟧.
This is best done in a run where the emperor stays thanks to the massive boost to compliance gain that the ⟦0⟧ focus grants.
This may be easier on non-historical mode, depending on what factions the colonial powers join. Furthermore, there is a chance that the ⟦0⟧ completely decolonizes on non-historical.
Stay on your owned territory or the territory of your puppets. Do not capture the ⟦0⟧ territory of ⟦1⟧ or the ⟦2⟧.
Proceed to the focus ⟦0⟧ via ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. Then, liberate the African countries under the control of ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧.

For ⟦0⟧, liberate the ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and then ⟦3⟧. Time the liberation of ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ to occur with five days of each other using the guns decision. Accept ⟦6⟧ offer for peace. You now have three of the thirteen countries that you need for this achievement.

Aim to liberate the six African countries controlled by ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ by the middle of 1939. Do not wait for a liberation to complete for one African country before starting the liberation process for the next country. It takes time for resistance to rise to the 90% liberation point.

Since ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ will be at peace for at least the beginning of the liberation, it may be challenging to increase resistance to the 90% point of rebellion. You may time your guns decision to complete when the state is at approximately 65% resistance. This will at least temporarily increase resistance by 30% and activate a rebellion, even if the Resistance Target for that state is less than 90%.
You now have nine of thirteen counties.

For ⟦0⟧, your first country liberation is certain to join your faction as ⟦1⟧ will not be at war with the ⟦2⟧. After the first liberation, ⟦3⟧ goes to war, joins the ⟦4⟧, and is at war with the ⟦5⟧. Aim to raise resistance in African countries distant from each other, not next to a country in the ⟦6⟧ faction, and comprised of one state. Good options are ⟦7⟧, the ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, and ⟦10⟧. While resistance is rising toward 90% in your first choices, start raising resistance in other African countries as backup options in case your first choices do not join your faction.
It is not necessary to go to war with the ⟦0⟧, unless you do so that the thirteenth country joins your faction and the achievement is complete.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
